tracers.name: GFP-sized protein (27 kDa) in cytoplasm
tracers.note: Translational diffusion coefficient measured by photobleaching recovery in cytoplasm (about 3x slower than in water, 87 µm²/s). It already includes crowding by macromolecules; CellLab adds obstruction by the rendered organelles on top.

tracers.name: GFP-sized protein (27 kDa) in water (reference)
tracers.note: Free diffusion in water, useful as a comparison to show the slow-down caused by the cell interior.
